title: The Ass and His Driver

full_text:
An ass being driven along a mountain ridge took a stubborn fit and turned toward a sheer precipice. His driver ran forward, seized his tail, and strained with all his might to pull him back to safety.

The obstinate beast dug in his hooves and lunged forward over the brink.

Letting go of the tail, the driver cried: "Have your way, stubborn fool! You have conquered your master, but at the cost of your life!" as the ass plunged into the abyss.
moral: Obstinate rebellion against guidance leads straight over the precipice.
